title: One-Dribble Pull-Up Pairs
description: Partners feed each other for a one-dribble attack into a pull-up jumper, training the quick in-between shot used to beat a closing defender.

content.objective: Catch, take exactly one hard dribble, and rise into a balanced pull-up jumper.
content.setup: A passer feeds a shooter who starts a step inside the three-point line.
instructions: The passer delivers the ball as the shooter is already stepping toward the rim.
The shooter takes exactly one hard dribble toward the basket.
Plant and rise into a quick pull-up jumper, no second dribble.
Rebound and rotate roles after ten reps each.
coachingPoints: Gather the ball on the move, not after stopping.
Keep the dribble low and quick, not a slow bounce.
Square the shoulders fully before releasing.
commonMistakes: Taking an extra dribble before rising up.
Fading away instead of going straight up on the jumper.
Dropping the follow-through early instead of holding it.
content.safety: Keep the rebound area clear for the shooter's landing.
